views.name: hardware_customer_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_code,
  customer,
  platform,
  channel,
  market,
  sub_zone,
  region
FROM hardware_dim_customer
views.description: Cleaned/passthrough customer dimension for joins. Use when you need customer descriptive attributes for reporting or joining to sales/deduction facts. | Use for: Join customers to sales, aggregate sales by market/platform/channel, filter customers by region or platform

views.name: hardware_product_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  product_code,
  division,
  segment,
  category,
  product,
  variant
FROM hardware_dim_product
views.description: Cleaned/passthrough product dimension. Use when you need product descriptive attributes for reporting or joining to price/cost/sales facts. | Use for: Aggregate sales by product category/segment/division, join price/cost to product attributes

views.name: hardware_sales_monthly_facts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  date,
  product_code,
  customer_code,
  sold_quantity,
  fiscal_year
FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly
views.description: Canonical monthly sales fact rows with core measures. Use as the base fact for time-series or fiscal analyses. | Use for: Monthly sales trends, product-customer monthly rollups, fiscal year comparisons

views.name: hardware_gross_price
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  product_code,
  fiscal_year,
  gross_price
FROM hardware_fact_gross_price
views.description: Gross price per product by fiscal year. Use to join pricing to sales or compute price-based margins by year. | Use for: Compute revenue estimates, price changes over years, join to sales or costs

views.name: hardware_manufacturing_cost
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  product_code,
  cost_year,
  manufacturing_cost
FROM hardware_fact_manufacturing_cost
views.description: Manufacturing cost per product by cost year. Use to compute unit margins when aligned with pricing/sales year. | Use for: Margin analysis, cost trends, join cost to price or sales by year

views.name: hardware_pre_invoice_deductions
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_code,
  fiscal_year,
  pre_invoice_discount_pct
FROM hardware_fact_pre_invoice_deductions
views.description: Per-customer pre-invoice discount percentage by fiscal year. Use to adjust gross amounts or compute net realizations per customer-year. | Use for: Customer net price calculations, discount impact by fiscal year, join to sales aggregated by customer-year

views.name: web_accounts_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  website,
  lat,
  long,
  primary_poc,
  sales_rep_id
FROM web_accounts
views.description: Account entity with location and sales-rep linkage. Use to join orders/events to sales reps or regions. | Use for: Map orders/events to sales reps/regions, spatial aggregations by lat/long, account-level reporting

views.name: web_orders_event_facts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  account_id,
  occurred_at,
  standard_qty,
  gloss_qty,
  poster_qty,
  total,
  standard_amt_usd,
  gloss_amt_usd,
  poster_amt_usd,
  total_amt_usd
FROM web_orders
views.description: Web orders fact with quantities and amounts. Use for revenue, product-mix (by qty types), and order-level analyses. | Use for: Revenue/time analyses, per-account order counts and amounts, product-format mix by amount/qty

views.name: web_events_facts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  account_id,
  occurred_at,
  channel
FROM web_events
views.description: Web events with timestamp and channel for session/engagement analysis. Use to count events per account or join to orders by time proximity. | Use for: Event counts by channel, funnel analyses joining events to orders

views.name: web_salesrep_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  region_id
FROM web_sales_reps
views.description: Sales rep dimension for joining account-level reps to regions and names. | Use for: Performance by sales rep, join accounts to rep and region

views.name: hardware_sales_by_product_customer_month
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  date,
  product_code,
  customer_code,
  SUM(sold_quantity) AS sold_quantity
FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly
GROUP BY date, product_code, customer_code
views.description: Aggregated sold_quantity per product/customer/month (date). Use for monthly reporting and joining to price/cost by fiscal year. | Use for: Monthly sales rollups, join to gross price/manufacturing cost by fiscal year to compute revenue/margin

views.name: hardware_sales_by_fiscal_product_customer
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  fiscal_year,
  product_code,
  customer_code,
  SUM(sold_quantity) AS sold_quantity
FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly
GROUP BY fiscal_year, product_code, customer_code
views.description: Aggregated sold_quantity by fiscal_year, product_code, and customer_code. Useful for fiscal-year reports and joining to fiscal-year priced facts. | Use for: Fiscal-year volume by product and customer, compute fiscal revenue/margins using year-aligned prices and costs

views.name: web_orders_with_account_rep
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.id,
  o.account_id,
  o.occurred_at,
  o.standard_qty,
  o.gloss_qty,
  o.poster_qty,
  o.total,
  o.standard_amt_usd,
  o.gloss_amt_usd,
  o.poster_amt_usd,
  o.total_amt_usd,
  a.name AS name,
  a.website AS website,
  a.lat AS lat,
  a.long AS long,
  a.primary_poc AS primary_poc,
  a.sales_rep_id AS sales_rep_id
FROM web_orders o
LEFT JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
views.description: Orders enriched with account and sales-rep attributes (rep id preserved). Use to analyze order amounts by rep, account or rep region. | Use for: Order revenue by sales rep, geographic mapping of orders, account-level order summaries

views.name: accounts_with_salesrep_region
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  a.id AS id,
  a.name AS name,
  a.website AS website,
  a.lat AS lat,
  a.long AS long,
  a.primary_poc AS primary_poc,
  a.sales_rep_id AS sales_rep_id,
  r.id AS id,
  r.name AS name
FROM web_accounts a
LEFT JOIN web_sales_reps s ON a.sales_rep_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN web_region r ON s.region_id = r.id
views.description: Accounts joined to sales rep and region name. Use to report accounts by regional organization or rep. | Use for: List accounts with rep and region, regional account counts

views.name: university_offering_with_faculty
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.OfferNo,
  o.CourseNo,
  o.OffTerm,
  o.OffYear,
  o.OffLocation,
  o.OffTime,
  o.FacNo,
  o.OffDays,
  f.FacFirstName AS FacFirstName,
  f.FacLastName AS FacLastName,
  f.FacDept AS FacDept,
  f.FacRank AS FacRank,
  f.FacSalary AS FacSalary
FROM university_offering o
LEFT JOIN university_faculty f ON o.FacNo = f.FacNo
views.description: Course offerings joined to faculty attributes. Use for faculty workload, offerings by department or term. | Use for: Faculty assignment per offering, offerings by term/year/department, salary-linked workload

views.name: course_offering_enrollment_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  e.OfferNo,
  COUNT(e.StdNo) AS enrolled_students,
  AVG(e.EnrGrade) AS avg_enr_grade
FROM university_enrollment e
GROUP BY e.OfferNo
views.description: Enrollment counts and average grade per offering. Use to analyze class sizes and average performance by offering. | Use for: Class size reporting, grade distributions by offering, join to offering metadata

views.name: student_course_enrollments
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.StdNo,
  s.StdFirstName,
  s.StdLastName,
  s.StdMajor,
  s.StdClass,
  s.StdGPA,
  e.OfferNo,
  e.EnrGrade
FROM university_student s
LEFT JOIN university_enrollment e ON s.StdNo = e.StdNo
views.description: Students joined with their enrollments and offering metadata. Use for student transcript-like views or per-student course lists. | Use for: Per-student course lists, GPA versus course grades, enrollment counts by major/class

views.name: staffhours_events_normalized
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  StaffMember,
  EventDate,
  EventTime,
  EventType
FROM StaffHours
views.description: Staff hours raw events (enter/exit) as-is for pairing into shifts. Use prior to pairing Enter/Exit by StaffMember and EventDate. | Use for: Compute hours worked by pairing Enter/Exit, detect missing exits/enters, per-staff daily attendance
